title: An editor creates a first variant definition by hand

steps.title: Open the Variants tool
steps.expect: The shipped overview lists definitions with document counts. An empty state offers to create the first one.

steps.title: Start a new definition
steps.expect: A dialog asks for the dimension and the definition title.

steps.title: Add the first condition
steps.expect: The same dialog takes one condition (for example locale = de-DE) and saves.

steps.title: See the definition in the list
steps.expect: The detail page of the new definition shows 0 documents and a Create action.

title: An editor changes a variant definition

steps.title: Open a definition
steps.expect: The detail page shows the definition, its conditions and its documents.

steps.title: Change a condition
steps.expect: The Edit dialog opens with the conditions of the definition.

steps.title: Read the consequence
steps.expect: The dialog names how many documents the change affects before saving.

steps.title: Open a base document
steps.expect: The document list shows the base document with its version mark.

steps.title: Open the perspective control
steps.expect: The version pill opens its menu. An extra row adds a dimension.

steps.title: Pick a dimension and a definition
steps.expect: The perspective row appears. The studio shows the chosen variant, or the base if none exists.

steps.title: See the missing-variant banner
steps.expect: A banner says this document has no version for the shown variant and offers Create.

steps.title: Create the variant document
steps.expect: The variant is created from the base as a draft. The banner disappears.

steps.title: Open a document list
steps.expect: Rows carry a version mark for documents that have versions.

steps.title: Click the mark
steps.expect: The base document opens with the version inventory beside it.

steps.title: Read the inventory
steps.expect: One row per stored version, with address and state.

steps.title: Open a version from the inventory
steps.expect: The document shows that version.

steps.title: Open a definition in the Variants tool
steps.expect: The detail table lists documents that have the version. Grey rows list documents that do not.

steps.title: Select the grey rows
steps.expect: The bulk bar offers Create and Add to release.

steps.title: Confirm the creation
steps.expect: The dialog names the address, the release and who is affected.

steps.title: Verify
steps.expect: Per-row results show. The grey rows are now drafts, counted as pending.

steps.title: Open the version menu
steps.expect: Published and Drafts show. Release sections show only if releases are on.

steps.title: Add a dimension
steps.expect: The panel opens; one dimension in open beta.

steps.title: Choose a value
steps.expect: The row shows one chip. The studio shows that perspective.

steps.title: Hide and show the row
steps.expect: The version label toggles the row. The chip stays set.

steps.title: Clear
steps.expect: The chip is removed and the studio returns to the base.

steps.title: Open Presentation
steps.expect: The preview loads with the same perspective control as the studio.

steps.title: Choose a dimension value
steps.expect: Choosing a value in the preview toolbar re-renders the preview for that audience. (Open question: the Presentation tool has only the navbar pill today.)

steps.title: Click to edit
steps.expect: The document opens in the version the preview shows.

title: An editor reads the dimension map and proposes a change

steps.title: Open Inventory, View by Dimension
steps.expect: One row per value with counts per lifecycle state.

steps.title: Find a definition with no documents
steps.expect: A definition shows 0 of n documents.

steps.title: Open its definition
steps.expect: The definition lens lists the documents with a Create action.

steps.title: Open View by Visitor
steps.expect: The visitor picker shows one value per dimension, default Anyone.

steps.title: Pick a visitor
steps.expect: Each document shows the version served and the grounds.

steps.title: Open a served document
steps.expect: The studio shows the served version. The banner appears only if the version is missing.

title: Delete a variant document from the document editor

steps.title: Open the variant version as its own document
steps.expect: The document opens on that version. The pane header names the variant and its state.

steps.title: Open the version inventory
steps.expect: The version rows are listed with states.

steps.title: Delete the variant version
steps.expect: A dialog names the version and which audience falls back to what.

steps.title: Verify
steps.expect: The row is gone. The base document is unchanged.

title: Delete a variant document from the Variants tool

steps.title: Open a definition
steps.expect: The detail table lists its documents.

steps.title: Select documents
steps.expect: The bulk bar shows Delete.

steps.title: Confirm the delete
steps.expect: The dialog lists each document and the fallback per audience.

steps.title: Read per-row results
steps.expect: Each row reports success or failure on its own.

title: Delete a variant definition that has no documents

steps.title: Open a definition with no documents
steps.expect: The detail page shows 0 documents.

steps.title: Delete the definition
steps.expect: A dialog confirms. No documents are affected.

steps.title: Verify
steps.expect: The definition is gone from the overview.

steps.title: Open the draft variant version as its own document
steps.expect: The document opens on the draft version. The pane header names the variant and its state.

steps.title: Open the version inventory
steps.expect: The draft row is listed.

steps.title: Publish the variant version
steps.expect: The row turns Published. The base is unchanged.

steps.title: Check the Releases tool
steps.expect: The Releases tool lists releases. A variant published on its own is not part of one.

title: An editor sees which fields differ from the base

steps.title: Open a variant version as its own document
steps.expect: The document opens on the variant. The pane header names the variant and its state.

steps.title: Read the marks in the form gutter
steps.expect: A purple mark sits beside every field whose value differs from the base. Identical fields have none. The tooltip says Changed from base variant.

steps.title: Read a nested object and an array
steps.expect: The changed leaf and its parent object are marked. An array shows one mark on the field, not on each item.

steps.title: Read a portable text field
steps.expect: The field carries one mark. Which paragraph changed is not marked in open beta.

steps.title: Open the same document in Presentation
steps.expect: The marks show in the narrow document pane without clipping.
